title: O Let Me Walk With Thee
print: the 1985 book's hymnary.org scan (p539.jpg), each line read off the page at its system and row; the rulings (data/crops/554/rulings.json) put in what the page prints where the base row differs: "iil" -> "I'll" (words, crops p539-275.jpg, judge-554 (Opus, effort max)).

stanzas.text: O let me walk with Thee, my God,
stanzas.from: p539.jpg system 1, row 1. (placed off the page by from-547 (Opus))

stanzas.text: As Enoch walked in days of old;
stanzas.from: p539.jpg system 1, row 1. (placed off the page by from-547 (Opus))

stanzas.text: Place Thou my trembling hand in Thine,
stanzas.from: p539.jpg system 2, row 1. (placed off the page by from-547 (Opus))

stanzas.text: And sweet communion with me hold;
stanzas.from: p539.jpg system 2, row 1. (placed off the page by from-547 (Opus))

stanzas.text: E'en though the path I may not see,
stanzas.from: p539.jpg system 3, row 1. (placed off the page by from-547 (Opus))

stanzas.text: Yet, Jesus, let me walk with Thee.
stanzas.from: p539.jpg system 3, row 1. (placed off the page by from-547 (Opus))

stanzas.text: I cannot, dare not, walk alone;
stanzas.from: p539.jpg system 1, row 2. (placed off the page by from-547 (Opus))

stanzas.text: The tempest rages in the sky,
stanzas.from: p539.jpg system 1, row 2. (placed off the page by from-547 (Opus))

stanzas.text: A thousand snares beset my feet,
stanzas.from: p539.jpg system 2, row 2. (placed off the page by from-547 (Opus))

stanzas.text: A thousand foes are lurking nigh.
stanzas.from: p539.jpg system 2, row 2. (placed off the page by from-547 (Opus))

stanzas.text: Still Thou the raging of the sea,
stanzas.from: p539.jpg system 3, row 2. (placed off the page by from-547 (Opus))

stanzas.text: O Master! let me walk with Thee.
stanzas.from: p539.jpg system 3, row 2. (placed off the page by from-547 (Opus))

stanzas.text: If I may rest my hand in Thine,
stanzas.from: p539.jpg system 1, row 3. (placed off the page by from-547 (Opus))

stanzas.text: I'll count the joys of earth but loss,
stanzas.from: p539.jpg system 1, row 3. (placed off the page by from-547 (Opus))
p539.jpg system 2, row 3. (placed off the page by from-547 (Opus))

stanzas.text: I'll bear the banner of the cross
stanzas.from: p539.jpg system 2, row 3. (placed off the page by from-547 (Opus))

stanzas.text: Till Zion's glorious gates I see;
stanzas.from: p539.jpg system 3, row 3. (placed off the page by from-547 (Opus))

stanzas.text: Yet, Savior, let me walk with Thee.
stanzas.from: p539.jpg system 3, row 3. (placed off the page by from-547 (Opus))

replaces.text:
I cannot, dare not, walk alone;
The tempest rages in the sky,
A thousand snares beset my feet,
A thousand foes are lurking nigh.
Still Thou the raging of the sea,
O Master! let me walk with Thee.
